stories.title: Besuch in der Türkei: Wüst: Erdogan zeigt Interesse an deutschen Wahlergebnissen

en.title: Visit to Turkey: Wüst: Erdogan shows interest in German election results
en.summary: During a visit to Turkey, Wüst reported that President Erdogan expressed interest in the outcomes of German elections.

stories.title: Russland stellt deutschen Großhändler Metro unter Zwangsverwaltung

en.title: Russia places German wholesaler Metro under compulsory administration
en.summary: Metro, which remained in Russia after the invasion of Ukraine unlike many other international companies, has now lost its business operations in the country through forced state administration.

stories.title: Metro AG in Russland: Wladimir Putin stellt Russland-Geschäft unter Zwangsverwaltung

en.title: Metro AG in Russia: Vladimir Putin places Russian business under compulsory administration
en.summary: Metro AG, one of few German companies that continued operations in Russia following the Ukraine invasion, has had all its Russian assets nationalized by the state.

stories.title: Nach massiver Kritik: Warum sich Spahn schon wieder zurückzieht

en.title: After massive criticism: Why Spahn is withdrawing again
en.summary: The former faction leader's return to political prominence was brief, as his private life became controversial once more and provoked discontent within his own party.

stories.title: News des Tages: Spahns Rückzug aus dem Haushaltsausschuss, Schließung der Biontech-Werke, Klopp und die Schlappe gegen Griechenland

en.title: News of the Day: Spahn's Withdrawal from Budget Committee, BioNTech Plant Closures, Klopp and Germany's Loss to Greece
en.summary: Jens Spahn has withdrawn from the budget committee after his political comeback attempt failed. BioNTech is closing three production facilities, and Germany's football team suffered a defeat under coach Klopp.

stories.title: Akademie der Wissenschaften in Kiew steht nach russischem Angriff in Flammen

en.title: National Academy of Sciences Building in Kyiv Engulfed in Flames Following Russian Attack
en.summary: A Russian military strike hit the historic building of Ukraine's National Academy of Sciences in Kyiv, causing a fire. At least one person was killed and rescue workers are searching for additional victims; other regions were also shelled.

en.title: Three German BioNTech Plants Must Close
en.summary: Pharmaceutical company BioNTech is closing three German production facilities in Marburg, Idar-Oberstein, and Tübingen. Approximately 1,800 employees currently work at these sites.

stories.title: Pharma: Keine Käufer gefunden: Drei deutsche Biontech-Standorte werden geschlossen

en.title: Pharmaceuticals: No Buyers Found; Three German BioNTech Sites Being Closed
en.summary: BioNTech, which earned billions during the pandemic, is reducing costs and cutting staff after being unable to find buyers for three production locations. The facilities will permanently close.

stories.title: Biontech: Pharmakonzern macht drei Standorte in Deutschland dicht

en.title: Biontech: Pharmaceutical company closes three locations in Germany
en.summary: Biontech, which earned billions during the COVID-19 pandemic, is shutting down three German facilities after failing to find buyers. The closures will affect 1,800 employees.

stories.title: Business-Ticker: Kein Käufer gefunden: Drei deutsche Biontech-Standorte werden geschlossen

en.title: Business Ticker: No buyer found: Three German Biontech locations being closed
en.summary: Multiple corporate developments are reported, including the closure of three Biontech facilities in Germany due to lack of buyers, alongside other business news from various companies.

stories.title: Newsblog zur Bundespolitik: Spahn verzichtet nach massiver Kritik auf Sitz im Haushaltsausschuss

en.title: News blog on federal politics: Spahn relinquishes seat on budget committee following massive criticism
en.summary: Jens Spahn has stepped down from his position on the budget committee after facing criticism over a Sardinia trip. He cited inability to work normally due to the controversy.

stories.title: CDU: Jens Spahn räumt nach Ärger über versäumte Sitzungen Posten im Haushaltsausschuss

en.title: CDU: Jens Spahn steps down from budget committee position following controversy over missed meetings
en.summary: Jens Spahn has relinquished his seat on the important parliamentary budget committee, stating that normal work has become nearly impossible for him.

stories.title: Märkte Insight: Die Nike-Aktie zeigt, wo Bewertungen an ihre Grenzen stoßen

en.title: Markets Insight: The Nike Stock Shows Where Valuations Hit Their Limits
en.summary: Nike's stock price and valuation have both declined. An analyst cautions that purchasing based solely on lower valuations may be a mistake.

stories.title: Geldanlage: Verlieren Aktien wirklich immer, wenn die Renditen von Anleihen steigen?

en.title: Investment: Do Stocks Really Always Lose When Bond Yields Rise?
en.summary: US government bonds are offering historically high returns. Data analysis suggests rising bond yields could present a buying opportunity in equities, contrary to investor concerns.

stories.title: BASF-Offerte: Übernahmepoker um Evonik ist nicht vorbei – drei Szenarien sind möglich

en.title: BASF Offer: Evonik Takeover Negotiations Not Over – Three Scenarios Possible
en.summary: Evonik rejected BASF's initial takeover offer. The RAG Foundation's position remains crucial, with political and labor involvement complicating negotiations and creating potential conflicts of interest.

stories.title: Geldanlage: Unterbewertete Aktien gesucht: US-Investor setzt auf zwei deutsche Titel – und einen aus der Schweiz

en.title: Investment: Undervalued Stocks Sought: US Investor Backs Two German Companies – and One from Switzerland
en.summary: A value-focused US investor has identified Adidas, Brenntag, and Samsung as opportunities. Beyond low valuations, he emphasizes that management quality and execution capability are essential selection criteria.

stories.title: Soziale Sicherung: Koalitionskrach um die Pflege – und was die SPD-Vorschläge kosten würden

en.title: Social Security: Coalition Clash Over Care – and What SPD Proposals Would Cost
en.summary: The SPD is blocking a care reform and proposes capping costs while including privately insured individuals. Economists warn this could be expensive and is creating tension with coalition partners.
